column1: @ SELECT hex(substr(n.value, 1, 1)) AS h, c.nightly, c.target, c.source, c.result, c.error_digest, c.time, c.log_index FROM compat c JOIN names n ON n.id = c.artifact ORDER BY n.value, c.nightly, c.target, c.source
@ SELECT nightly, target, upto_log_index, time FROM sweeps ORDER BY nightly, target
@ SELECT nightly, target, previous, compared, changed FROM transitions ORDER BY nightly, target
